Emily Li: Quick sync — AtlasCloud + Concord HW bundle go-live checklist. Need final owners for press copy, microsite hero, and marketplace SKU mapping. Who's on press lead?
Rahul Patel: I can own press copy. Will draft TL;DR + 2 quotes. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sasha Gomez: I’ll take microsite hero and CTA flow. Do we have final imagery from design?
Marco Rinaldi: Design uploaded v3 to Figma: https://figma.com/file/atlas-concord/v3 — Sasha please review. Also need SKU mapping for the marketplace — I’ll coordinate with partner onboarding.
Zoe Chen: FYI legal flagged two IP mentions in the joint announcement. @Emily can you re-run with legal comments?
Emily Li: Yep, will iterate. Can someone confirm embargo window? Partner Ops suggested 2026-04-12 10:00 PT.
Rahul Patel: That works. Will include embargo notice at top of press doc.
Sasha Gomez: Microsite needs localized hero copy (EN/FR/DE/JA). Can we get translation lead? @Marco?
Marco Rinaldi: Looping in localisation vendor; ETA for first pass is +48h.
Zoe Chen: Marketplace SKU note: Concord-HW-Bundle-XL maps to atlas:concord.bundle.xl — include that in deployment YAML.
Marco Rinaldi: Pushing SKU sync to partner portal today. I'll confirm the marketplace listing ID by EOD.
Emily Li: Small ops ask — add UTM params to all social links: ?utm_source=partner-atlas&utm_campaign=concord-launch&utm_medium=referral
Rahul Patel: Adding to press kit. Also want to call out SI integration case study on blog. Do we have an SI ready?
Sasha Gomez: SI sample: Nebula Integrations did a pilot. Can we get a short blurb and logo?
Marco Rinaldi: Nebula signed LOA — they approved a 2-paragraph case snippet. I'll attach.
Zoe Chen: Legal signoff on press and case study required. Emily, once you update, I'll route to legal for fast-track.
Emily Li: Great. Action items: Rahul = press copy + quotes; Sasha = microsite + localization; Marco = SKU + SI assets; Zoe = legal gating. I'll compile an assets checklist and post here in morning.
deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing draft deployed to staging at 1808889000. Please verify links and SKU matches.
Sasha Gomez: Verified staging hero + CTA. One broken image (hero@2x). @Marco can you re-upload?
Marco Rinaldi: Re-uploaded hero@2x to S3 and invalidated CDN. Should be live in ~5m.
Rahul Patel: Draft press sent to Emily and Zoe for review (link: google.com/press-draft).
Emily Li: Received. Quick note: remove numeric perf claim — legal preferred qualitative wording.
Zoe Chen: Acknowledged. Legal will return comments by tomorrow 9am PT.
Emily Li: Final check — who is on the 4/12 launch war room? I’ll be on standby with Rahul and Marco. Sasha, Zoe, can you be on-call for first 2 hours?
Sasha Gomez: Yes.
Zoe Chen: Yes.
Marco Rinaldi: Yes.
Emily Li: Perfect. Closing this thread — I’ll post the compiled checklist (assets + owners + links) by 10am PT tomorrow. :rocket:
